case_number: 2024 INSC 667; CIVIL APPEAL NOS.2809-2810 OF 2024; CIVIL APPEAL NO.6344 OF 2024
summary: Consumer protection appeal arising from housing project dispute; possession offered without completion/firefighting certificates; delayed payment due to alleged construction deficiencies; refund ordered with interest @9% p.a. from complaint date; NCDRC jurisdiction upheld; limitation plea rejected due to ADA's subsequent demands; technical objections overruled; deficiency in service established despite delayed payment of balance amount; interest not awarded from deposit date due to waiver requests.
legal_provisions_cited: Order XXIV of Supreme Court Rules
final_judgment: Appeals partly allowed; refund of entire amount excluding stamp paper costs directed with interest @9% from complaint date maintained.
